title: Palworld

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Palworld as a digital open-world creature-collection holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title. Online multiplayer components depend on Pocketpair services.
preservation.concerns: Account-bound digital holdings face platform dependency and policy change. Multiplayer services increase long-term access risk. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Entered Steam Early Access in January 2024. Steam storefront date for the current edition is July 9, 2026. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
